notes: Values from PS-MPU-6000A-00 rev 3.4. mount_offset_m / mount_rotation_wxyz are placeholders until CAD pins the IMU board location. publish_orientation=true is convenient for RTAB-Map; toggle to false in Phase 5 for stricter sim-to-real (the real chip only outputs raw accel + gyro). Filter sizes are Isaac Sim's IMU sensor smoothing windows (1 = no smoothing, matches the i2c raw stream).
